caption: Thirty second prediction markets
say: Prediction markets are slow. The quickest one you can name takes five minutes to settle. Tick settles in thirty seconds.

caption: Opens on a feed, not a trading screen
say: And it doesn't open on a trading screen. It opens on a feed, where the thing people post is their profit.

caption: One question per market
say: Every market is one question. Will this price be higher, thirty seconds from now.

caption: Live chart, two sides, from ten cents
say: You get the live chart, the strike, and two sides. Ten cents is enough to take one. It settles on Pyth, on chain. Nobody referees it.

caption: Groups and rooms, on chain
say: The part that makes it stick is the group. Rooms, chat, and a leaderboard, all of it on chain.

caption: The room races a live scoreboard
say: The owner picks a market. Everyone calls the same thirty seconds, and the table re-sorts as each window settles.

caption: Every win becomes a verified card
say: Win, and Tick draws your card from your real record. Verified on chain, so the number can't be faked.

caption: Tick. Compete in groups. Flex your profits.
say: Thirty second markets, for people who'd rather trade with their friends. Tick.
